mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 68 degrees with clear skies by the Military Ridge State Trail under a Waning Gibbous moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight will drop to 57 degrees with rain predicted.

The City of Verona continues its contract for engineering services with AECOM Inc. Additionally, the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is holding public meetings for the US 18/151 Corridor Study between Dodgeville and Fitchburg to discuss design concepts.

There is plenty to do in Verona today, including Live Music at Paddy Mac's, Yoga at Insight Wellness, Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, tomorrow features ART House 360 Thursday nights and Hop Haus Trivia.
In a noteworthy call for service on October 25, officers located a driver passed out at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, which resulted in an arrest for O W I.
Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10 PM tonight, serving up the delicious Chocolate Heath Crunch as the flavor of the day.
